concept_uz: Sonlar kvadrat minoralar va ildiz yertoʻlalarini kashf qiladi: 25 kirsa — 5 chiqadi. Qiziquvchan Ikki tushadi-yu, chiqa olmaydi: kvadrati aniq 2 boʻladigan kasr yoʻq. U qafas bilan chiqadi, ismi pasportga sigʻmaydi — 1,41421356… Sonlar oʻqida teshik borligi maʼlum boʻladi.
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, gentle split light — cool moonlight from the left, warm sunlight from the right — soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round king shaped like a thick, chunky upright ring with a small hole in the middle, so its wide front face is a disc. The ring is coloured like a yin-yang: the left half dark moon-silver with one small bright gold dot, the right half bright sun-gold with one small dark silver dot, the two halves curving into each other in a smooth S-shaped wave — made of polished metal, not a flat printed symbol. Big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast low-poly crystal plain, exactly where the cool left side meets the warm right side, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty low-poly crystal plain made of smooth faceted triangular polygons: cool lavender-blue facets on the left, warm amber facets on the right, blending softly in the middle. A thin glowing straight path runs across the ground from left to right through the centre. The sky is split the same gentle way: soft twilight indigo with a few stars on the left, where a pale moon with a gentle old woman's face smiles; warm morning light on the right, where a big warm sun with a kind old grandfather's face — smiling eyes, bushy eyebrows and a beard of rays — smiles back. Not dark, just a gentle difference between the two sides. No characters.

Vertical 9:16. The king's long wooden staff lying flat on the low-poly crystal plain from left to right, with evenly spaced carved notches along it, the middle notch glowing gold. Low camera angle along the staff, morning light, no characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A tall, thoughtful teal character with a graceful swan-like curved neck and a flat base, gentle sad eyes, standing inside a glass cage whose front edge is shaped like a large tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). Moody evening light on the low-poly crystal plain, front view, centred.

On this low-poly crystal plain build a tall tower of stacked golden blocks, and at its foot a cellar door whose frame is shaped like a big tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). A queue of small excited number-characters waits at the door. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: Slow crane shot from the top of the tall tower of blocks down to the root-shaped cellar door, a queue of characters waiting. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, velvety storyteller's voice, slow and mysterious like an old radio fairy tale: "Sonlar minoralar qurib, yerto'lalar qazishni o'rganibdi…" Lip-sync: nobody on screen speaks — the narrator is heard off screen and every mouth stays closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Sonlar minoralar qurib, yertoʻlalar qazishni oʻrganibdi…

scenes.prompt: A character climbs down into the root-shaped cellar door and pops out a moment later smaller, proud and shining; the queue claps. It says in Uzbek with an excited, high young voice: "Yigirma besh kirdi — besh chiqdi!" Lip-sync: only the character that just came out of the cellar moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

A tall thoughtful teal character with a swan-like curved neck steps out of the queue, peers into the dark cellar and says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad voice of a gentle young man: "Ichkarida nima bor ekan?" Then it climbs in. Lip-sync: only the tall teal character moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The cellar door slams shut. Banging from inside and a muffled voice says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad voice of a gentle young man: "Chiqolmayapman!" Characters outside shout numbers through the keyhole, then shake their heads. Lip-sync: nobody on screen speaks — the muffled voice inside the cellar is heard off screen and every mouth stays closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The teal character finally walks out of the cellar slowly — but now a glass cage shaped like the root sign surrounds it and moves with it. It looks down at the cage sadly. The crowd steps back. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

At the palace gate a guard with a long scroll asks, says in Uzbek with a slow, bored, nasal voice of a palace guard: "Ismingiz?" The caged character answers slowly, says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad voice of a gentle young man: "Bir butun, to'rt, bir, to'rt, ikki, bir, uch, besh…" Time-lapse: the sun sets while the guard keeps writing, the scroll piling up on the ground. Lip-sync: the lines are spoken in this order — the guard with the scroll, then the caged teal character; each mouth moves only during its own line and everyone else keeps their mouth closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bir butun, toʻrt, bir, toʻrt, ikki, bir, uch, besh…

scenes.prompt: Night at the gate; the guard is asleep on the huge pile of scroll. The caged character sighs and says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad voice of a gentle young man: "Ismim pasportga sig'mayapti." Lip-sync: only the caged teal character moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The ring-king walks along the glowing staff and suddenly stops: between two notches, exactly under the caged character, there is a tiny dark hole in the line that no notch covers. He gasps and says in Uzbek with a deep, warm, slightly theatrical baritone voice of a kind middle-aged king, slow, with dramatic pauses: "O'qda teshik bor ekan!" Lip-sync: only the yin-yang ring-king moves its mouth and speaks; every other character keeps its mouth closed and just listens. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Dusk. The ring-king sadly points his staff toward the horizon; the caged character and a few other caged characters walk away into the dark distance, where they gather in a circle and begin to whisper. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, deep, velvety storyteller's voice, slow and mysterious like an old radio fairy tale: "Davomi — powerty.uz da." Lip-sync: nobody on screen speaks — the narrator is heard off screen and every mouth stays closed. No subtitles, no on-screen text.
